 Updated : 12 hours ago | News
 Nashville murder investigations, $50K cold case reward and Tennessee election updates - clipped version 
 Updated : 16 hours ago | WSMV4’s Joylyn Bukovac brings you the latest local headlines from Middle Tennessee on Sunday, October 18, 2026.
Metro Nashville Police have identified 64-year-old Johnny Menifee, who was found shot to death inside his North Nashville apartment.
Investigators are also searching for three men connected to a deadly ambush shooting in Madison that left one man dead and his 14-year-old brother critically injured.
In Rutherford County, investigators are offering a $50,000 reward for information in the 2015 murder of Greg Hawkins.
Plus, police are investigating an attempted armed robbery near a Clarksville furniture store.
We’re also following the latest developments surrounding Tennessee’s upcoming election, including reported death threats against a state House candidate, warnings about election misinformation and the race for governor.
